---
title: "Blood products — marginal rates, rate ratio, and rate difference"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(marginaleffects)
library(ggdist)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "07-blood-products", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

blood_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"))
completed_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))

blood_fits <- expand_grid(
  outcome = c("blood_products", "erythrocytes", "thrombocytes"),
  adjustment = c("adjusted", "unadjusted")
) |>
  mutate(fits = map2(outcome, adjustment, \(outcome, adjustment) {
    readRDS(file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0("model-", outcome, "-", adjustment, ".rds")
    ))
  }))

rate_days <- 30

outcome_labels <- c(
  blood_products = "All blood products (prespecified)",
  erythrocytes = "Erythrocyte concentrates",
  thrombocytes = "Thrombocyte concentrates"
)
```

## Marginal rates

```{r}
#| label: marginal-rates

rate_draws <- blood_fits |>
  mutate(draws = map2(fits, adjustment, \(fits, adjustment) {
    prediction_data <- if (adjustment == "adjusted") {
      completed_datasets
    } else {
      list(blood_data)
    }

    map2(fits, prediction_data, \(fit, data) {
      fit <- set_modeldata(fit, data)

      counterfactual_data <- bind_rows(
        data |> mutate(tx = 0),
        data |> mutate(tx = 1)
      ) |>
        mutate(exposure_days = rate_days)

      avg_predictions(
        fit,
        newdata = counterfactual_data,
        by = "tx",
        type = "response"
      ) |>
        get_draws() |>
        mutate(drawid = as.integer(as.character(drawid))) |>
        # brms orders draws by chain, so this keeps the first chain's draws.
        filter(drawid <= config$posterior_draws$supporting) |>
        select(tx, drawid, draw)
    }) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "imputation")
  })) |>
  select(outcome, adjustment, draws) |>
  unnest(draws)
```

```{r}
#| label: contrasts

blood_draws <- rate_draws |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw, names_prefix = "rate_tx") |>
  mutate(
    rate_ratio = rate_tx1 / rate_tx0,
    rate_difference = rate_tx1 - rate_tx0
  )

write_parquet(
  blood_draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Summary

- Adjusted rates and differences have extreme right tails (tiny shape); the rate ratio does not.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-blood-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior marginal rates per 30 days, rate ratio, and rate difference (ctDNA - usual care)"

blood_summary <- blood_draws |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(rate_tx0, rate_tx1, rate_ratio, rate_difference),
    names_to = "quantity",
    values_to = "draw"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    posterior_median = median(draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
    probability_lower_rate = case_when(
      quantity[1] == "rate_ratio" ~ mean(draw < 1),
      quantity[1] == "rate_difference" ~ mean(draw < 0)
    ),
    .by = c(outcome, adjustment, quantity)
  )

write_parquet(
  blood_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

kable(blood_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: plot-setup

plot_draws <- blood_draws |>
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome_labels[outcome], levels = outcome_labels),
    adjustment = factor(
      str_to_sentence(adjustment),
      levels = c("Adjusted", "Unadjusted")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-blood-rate-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Posterior marginal rate ratio (ctDNA / usual care), adjusted and unadjusted, for all blood products and for erythrocyte and thrombocyte concentrates separately. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Six panels, one row per outcome (all blood products, erythrocyte concentrates, thrombocyte concentrates) and one column per model (adjusted, unadjusted), each with a half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the marginal rate ratio, ctDNA over usual care, on a log scale, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals and a dashed vertical line at a ratio of one."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

rate_ratio_plot <- plot_posterior(
  plot_draws |> mutate(draw = rate_ratio),
  x_label = "Rate ratio (ctDNA / usual care)",
  reference = 1,
  log_scale = TRUE
) +
  facet_wrap(vars(outcome, adjustment), ncol = 2)

save_figure(
  rate_ratio_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "blood-products-rate-ratio.png"),
  height = 9
)

rate_ratio_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-blood-rate-difference
#| fig-cap: "Posterior marginal difference in products per 30 days (ctDNA − usual care), adjusted and unadjusted, for all blood products and for erythrocyte and thrombocyte concentrates separately. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Six panels, one row per outcome (all blood products, erythrocyte concentrates, thrombocyte concentrates) and one column per model (adjusted, unadjusted), each with its own horizontal axis and a half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the marginal difference in products per 30 days, ctDNA minus usual care, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals and a dashed vertical line at zero."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

rate_difference_plot <- plot_posterior(
  plot_draws |> mutate(draw = rate_difference),
  x_label = "Difference in products per 30 days (ctDNA − usual care)",
  normalize = "panels"
) +
  facet_wrap(vars(outcome, adjustment), ncol = 2, scales = "free_x")

save_figure(
  rate_difference_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "blood-products-rate-difference.png"),
  height = 9
)

rate_difference_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-blood-marginal-rates
#| fig-cap: "Posterior marginal rate per 30 days by randomized group from the adjusted models. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Six panels, one row per outcome (all blood products, erythrocyte concentrates, thrombocyte concentrates) and one column per randomized group (ctDNA, usual care), each with its own horizontal axis and a half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the marginal number of products per 30 days from the adjusted model, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

# No reference line: a rate has no natural reference value.
marginal_rates_plot <- rate_draws |>
  filter(adjustment == "adjusted") |>
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome_labels[outcome], levels = outcome_labels),
    group = group_factor(tx)
  ) |>
  plot_posterior(x_label = "Products per 30 days", reference = NULL, normalize = "panels") +
  facet_wrap(vars(outcome, group), ncol = 2, scales = "free_x")

save_figure(
  marginal_rates_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "blood-products-marginal-rates.png"),
  height = 9
)

marginal_rates_plot
```
